body: U+0023# Manual-test app removed from the Note10+ (2026-10-01)U+000AU+000AU+002D At the owner's request: `pm clear`, then uninstall of `dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain`.U+000AU+002D Removed the Flutter install marker `/data/local/tmp/sky.dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain.sha1`.U+000AU+002D Verified on the phone:U+000A  U+002D no field-notes package is installed (real, plain, mbench, probe);U+000A  U+002D the package manager can no longer find the plain app;U+000A  U+002D no pending alarms;U+000A  U+002D no external storage folders.U+000AU+002D Left as is:U+000A  U+002D system history logs (alarm stats, Samsung edge-lighting log, package install records);U+000A  U+002D one stale "user set" list in the notification settings that names field_notes, .gbench, .mbench, .plain and .probe from earlier installs; no adb command removes it without touching other apps;U+000A  U+002D an empty `/data/local/tmp/dalvik-cache/arm64` folder from 2026-09-24 that predates this work.
